basis.acetylcholine: Cholinergic central neurons of Drosophila are reported to act through fast excitatory nicotinic receptors, so the rule fixes the sign at +1.
basis.dopamine: Dopamine acts through several G-protein-coupled receptor types whose effect depends on the receptor the postsynaptic cell expresses, which the release does not report, so the sign stays unknown.
basis.gaba: GABA is reported to act through the Rdl GABA-A chloride conductance in the fly central nervous system, so the rule fixes the sign at -1.
basis.glutamate: Fly glutamatergic connections are frequently inhibitory through the GluCl chloride channel while excitatory glutamate receptors also exist, so a fixed -1 is an engineering 假設 (engineering assumption) recorded here, not evidence in the release.
basis.histamine: Histamine is reported to gate the ort/HisCl chloride channels in the fly, so the rule fixes the sign at -1.
basis.octopamine: Octopamine is a modulator acting through G-protein-coupled receptors whose effect depends on the postsynaptic receptor, which the release does not report, so the sign stays unknown.
basis.serotonin: Serotonin acts through several G-protein-coupled receptor subtypes with opposite effects depending on the receptor, which the release does not report, so the sign stays unknown.
